title: Machine execution for an emitter run
statement: For every Boolean input list $w$, every Boolean list $l$, emitter state $s$, index $i\le |w|$, and output list $o$, suppose dropping the first $i$ bits of $w$ gives $l$ and each of the three counters in $s$ is at most $i$. Then there is a time $T\le (|l|+1)\,200(|w|+1)$ such that the machine started in the configuration determined by $w,s,i,o$ has halted after $T$ steps and its output is $o$ followed by the result of running the emitter from $s$ on $l$.
hypotheses_covered: Dropping the first $i$ bits of $w$ gives $l$
